_comment: Everything the dashboard's Apply kit lets you copy. Edit any value, save, and refresh the dashboard (no restart needed). Lines starting with EDIT ME are placeholders: replace them with your real answer. Your phone number is left out on purpose; add one {label, value} line to profile if you want it. This repo is public: do not commit a real salary number.

answers.label: Work authorization / how you work
answers.value: I am based in Nigeria and work as an independent contractor (B2B). I can invoice through Deel, Wise or Payoneer.

answers.label: Salary expectation
answers.value: Open to discussing a competitive rate based on the role and scope.

answers.label: Years of experience
answers.value: 3+ years building production web systems in TypeScript and Node.js.

answers.label: Full-time or contract?
answers.value: Open to both full-time and long-term contract roles.

summaries.fullstack_engineer: Full-stack software engineer with 3+ years building production web systems in TypeScript and Node.js, with a focus on correctness under concurrency and payments. Sole full-stack engineer on iTurf, a football turf booking and tournament platform (Next.js 14, ElysiaJS/Bun, PostgreSQL), where I built Redis-based slot locking, Paystack payment and refund flows, and a k6 load test that verifies double-booking protection under contention.
summaries.backend_engineer: Backend-leaning software engineer with 3+ years in TypeScript and Node.js. Built Paystack payment, refund and webhook-verification flows, Redis TTL-based slot locking, and real-time features over WebSockets on PostgreSQL (Supabase, PostGIS) with Drizzle ORM. Covered the booking pipeline with unit and integration tests, a k6 load test of 50 concurrent users on a single slot, and GitHub Actions CI.
summaries.frontend_engineer: Software engineer with 3+ years building production web applications in React, TypeScript and Next.js. Led frontend development of the i-Academy learning portal at Heirs Technologies from scratch to a fully deployed, client-facing platform, and built the complete frontend for Heirs Assistant, including real-time streaming chat over Server-Sent Events.
